about: Courtenay is a city on Vancouver Island’s east coast, at the head of the Courtenay River estuary facing Comox Harbour. It is the largest urban centre in the Comox Valley, paired with neighbouring Comox and Cumberland. Mountains, estuary trails, and a revitalized downtown define the city’s character. About 28,000 people live in Courtenay.
seoSummary: Comox Valley’s main city on Vancouver Island, at the Courtenay River estuary.
knownFor: Hub city of the Comox Valley
